create_TPOConfig: create a TPOConfig instance with custom learning_rate, loss_type, and beta for pairwise preference training
build_TPOConfig_defaults: build a TPOConfig with default values for max_length, truncation_mode, and disable_dropout
test_TPOConfig_fields: test the TPOConfig dataclass fields including loss_type choices and tpo_l_gamma parameter
review_TPOConfig_inheritance: review the TPOConfig class that inherits from _BaseConfig with overridden TrainingArguments defaults
summarize_TPOConfig_parameters: summarize the TPOConfig training parameters including tpo_alpha, beta, and label_smoothing
